semantic_interpretation_segments.interpretation: Historical Locked AI primary purpose is coffee URL/screenshot extraction and structuring, not AI invocation on every shot; closing brace/separator finish the decision. Later explicit screenshot retirement and deterministic-only scope must be applied narrowly.
Stable canonical coffee and release identity, not mutable shared keys. Opening and closing JSON delimiters define one Locked record; prevent ID collapse when removing apparently redundant keys.
Separate harvest, lot and release entities remain linked rather than overwritten; archive and current SKU identity cannot be conflated.
Unavailability archives a coffee identity, never deletes it; history and member shots must survive discontinued products.
One validated Collective canonical facts record with member-submitted corrections; a user proposal is not automatic source truth.
Exact current official roaster source outranks secondary evidence; secondary claims require independently matching the exact coffee, not stale SEO slug or generic roaster page.
Unknown or unverified coffee fields remain blank; no inference or invented provenance during extractor cleanup.
Only strong nonconflicting corrections may auto-apply; conflicts require Admin review and audit history. Do not bypass privacy/approval controls for convenience.
Historical new-coffee input supports URL and/or screenshot; later explicit screenshot retirement is a scoped supersession and must not be silently reversed by this frozen source.
Canonical DB dedup precedes AI; exact match can attach, fuzzy match requires user confirmation. Preserve identity and duplicate avoidance across current code.
No AI key/new coffee creates private Pending Coffee and allows immediate shot logging until approval; do not block Log Shot on unverified extraction.
Discard member screenshots after extraction while retaining structured provenance and appropriate official images. This is a privacy/retention guard, not authorization to persist uploads.
Every shot is individually stored; aggregates are derived/cached, never replacements for raw shot history. Preserve offline and member records.
Next Locked shots/community eligibility record opens with status and area only; its topic and decision are beyond this batch and deliberately not credited.
